about: 22 official surveys: each question's published answer, overall and by group, with the PersonaGen field and values that define each group. real: weighted shares in percent. n: unweighted respondents. drawn: of the 300 PersonaGen people drawn for the study's population in the original benchmark, how many fell in the group; a group is scored when 30 or more did, and drawn weights the groups of a dimension.

studies.title: Formal volunteering in the last 12 months

source.name: Community and Engagement Survey 2025/26: volunteering and charitable giving (data tables)
source.organisation: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

studies.population: Adults 16 and over in England
studies.context: Groups, clubs and organisations include, for example, children's education or schools, youth activities, sport or exercise, religion, politics, older people, health or social welfare, the environment or animals, local community groups, hobbies or social clubs, and trade unions.
studies.question: In the last 12 months, have you given any unpaid help to any groups, clubs or organisations: for example raising money, leading a group or being on a committee, organising or helping to run an activity or event, visiting or befriending people, giving advice, admin work, providing transport, or other practical help?
studies.note: DCMS's derived measure (formal volunteering in the last 12 months): involved in a group, club or organisation and gave it unpaid help in any of 13 listed ways. The question joins the survey's two steps; the examples are the survey's own lists (table G18).
